# Ash Heap Treasure Maps: Rewards Data Mining & All Locations

![Ash Heap Treasure Maps: Rewards Datamining & All Locations](/uploads/501_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Ash Heap treasure maps

### Ash Heap Treasure Map 01

The treasure can be found at the **AMS Proving Grounds**. Go to the barred tunnel entrance. To the left of it, on the slope, is the hill with the treasure.

### Ash Heap Treasure Map 02

From Rusty Pick, head towards **Hornwright Air Purifier Location #01**. A little further in this direction there are 3 houses around a pond. At the house with a jeep on the side, the treasure pile is to the left of the jeep.
